title: Sandbox samples runbook & pulse — Sep 02 2026
content:
Purpose:
This is a working pulse for the sandbox samples runbook experiment. Goal: reduce time-to-first-successful-run for new users following SDK quickstarts and sample projects, and surface the smallest set of infra/tests/telemetry that catches the top 4 failure modes in the next 2 sprints.

Attendees:
- Aisha (owner)
- Marco (samples maintainer)
- Sofia (DX SDK lead)
- Diego (QA / CI)
- Priya (docs & UX)

Quick summary / what changed since last check-in:
- Ran a 72-hour cohort test with 28 external signups using the "minimal-sandbox" sample. Observed 57% success-to-run rate (finished sample examples and got valid API response within 20 minutes). That is +9% vs baseline.
- Two new mitigations merged to samples repo: lightweight Dockerfile (multi-stage) and pre-warmed small model stub for local offline mode. PRs: #482 and #486.
- Instrumented a lightweight telemetry ping (sample-first-run metric) to capture failure stage: install vs auth vs runtime. Data shows majority fail in "auth" (token/ENV) and "network" (CORS / proxy).

Top symptoms we see (ranked):
1) Authentication confusion: env var names (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY) in example code.
2) CI flakes on macOS runners due to native wheel build for sample dependency (sentencepiece).
3) Long first-boot for the docker sandbox image when model artifacts download (n > 90s on slow links).
4) Prompt formatting mismatch between SDK major versions (v0.x vs v1.x) causing runtime errors in examples.

Decisions made in meeting:
- Standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY across all samples and add a preflight script that checks env var presence and prints exact remediation steps (copy paste lines). (Owner: Marco)
- Add a dedicated sample variant "minimal-offline" that uses a stubbed local model runtime so first-run succeeds instantly; keep it as default for "Try in browser" links. (Owner: Sofia)
- Introduce a small CI job that runs the sample's quickstart on a macOS-lite matrix with prebuilt wheels (cache) to avoid sentencepiece compile flakes. If caching is not reliable we will vendor a prebuilt wheel in the samples repo. (Owner: Diego, Ticket DX-4123)
- Update all sample README snippets to match SDK v1.x method names and include a one-line note about SDK pinning for reproducibility. (Owner: Priya)

Action items (with acceptance criteria and due dates):
- Marco: add preflight script + env var normalization across repo. Acceptance: sample run logs show 'preflight OK' before any network call. Due: 2026-09-08. Linked: github PR #495.
- Sofia: create minimal-offline sample and demo page (static sandbox). Acceptance: GitHub pages 'Try sample' returns 200 and shows stubbed response. Due: 2026-09-10.
- Diego: CI job prototype for macOS with wheel cache. Acceptance: pipeline shows green for 3 successive runs on matrix. Due: 2026-09-07. Ticket: DX-4123.
- Priya: sweep and update README snippets, add SDK pin and upgrade notes. Acceptance: 100% of quickstart READMEs have example method names matching SDK v1.x. Due: 2026-09-06.
- Aisha: draft funnel dashboard (time-to-first-run, failure stage breakdown, platform) and share with growth for feedback. Acceptance: dashboard shows cohort breakdown and two-week trend. Due: 2026-09-12.

Known blockers / risks:
- Vendor wheel approach might need legal / binary redistribution check. Diego to confirm with infra and legal before we vendor 3rd-party binaries.
- Pre-warmed model stub increases sample repo size (adds ~8MB). Need infra consent for CI caching and GH pages size.

Notes from the 72-hour cohort (raw observations):
- Install errors: 11 accounts failed during pip install; top error was 'wheel not found' for sentencepiece. Workaround: pip --no-build-isolation + prebuilt wheel.
- Auth errors: 8 accounts had invalid token formatting (extra quotes / newline copy paste). Users skip docs where token example is in inline code; we need a copy-button everywhere.
- Network errors: 4 accounts behind corporate proxy failed to download artifacts; the fallback should be to use 'minimal-offline' but we need clearer UX path.

Small experiments to run next (quick A/B ideas):
- A/B: copy-button vs no-copy-button on token section (measure auth error rate).
- A/B: default 'Try in browser' points to minimal-offline vs full sandbox (measure time-to-success and retention).
- Instrument sample-run funnel with redirect parameter to tag marketing sources (helps correlate sign-up channel to failure mode).

Checklist for landing this runbook into "official" quickstarts:
- [ ] preflight script in samples root + docs mention
- [ ] minimal-offline sample with stub model
- [ ] README snippets audited and pinned to SDK v1.x
- [ ] CI job added to sample repo for macOS matrix
- [ ] telemetry ping (sample-first-run) enabled and hooked to funnel dashboard

Backlog / nice-to-have (not for current sprint):
- Local dev extension that detects common proxy settings and generates a preconfigured docker-compose with envs populated.
- A short video (60–90s) demo embedded in README with closed captions.
- Automated remediation bot that comments on failing PRs with exact copy/paste fixes for common sample issues.

Questions for stakeholders:
- Growth: which traffic sources should we prioritize tagging in the funnel? (answer needed by 2026-09-09)
- Legal/infra: ok to vendor prebuilt sentencepiece wheel and small model stub into the repo? (decision needed before 2026-09-07)

Meeting notes (quick transcript-style highlights):
- Marco: "Preflight script feels low friction — we can detect env var mismatches and suggest exact export commands."
- Sofia: "Minimal-offline is surprisingly useful for demos and helps reduce support noise — shipping it first makes sense."
- Diego: "CI caching on macOS is flaky, but we can at least land a prototype and monitor cache hit rate."
- Priya: "Docs sweep will be a lot of small text changes — I can do a grep-based refactor and send a PR for review."

Next sync:
- Standup check on 2026-09-07 (short sync) to validate CI prototype and preflight script status. Full pulse review on 2026-09-13.

Appendix: useful commands / snippets (for contributors)
- Preflight: ./scripts/preflight.sh (prints ENV check, python version, network check to artifact host)
- Local run (minimal-offline): cd samples/minimal-offline && ./run_local_stub.sh
- How to repro CI macOS wheel issue locally: python -m pip install sentencepiece --verbose --no-binary :all:  # expect slow compile

End of doc.
